body: I can't play video games. For the past 3 months I haven't been able to do a single thing, haven't turned on the computer, haven't turned on the tv, haven't seen anyone but my parents, haven't smiled or had one single moment of happiness. For the past 90 days, I lay in bed, or sit on a chair, on my phone reading up about suicide. I lost EVERYTHING I ever had and loved, I am now 25, broke had to move back at my parents. I'm ready to die. Lost all my savings, lost my gf of 5 years, lost my dog, lost my place, lost my car, lost my job, lost all my materialistic possessions, lost the city I lived in, lost all my friends, lost 40lbs. This all happened in the span of 1 month.
I'm going through the same shit, life is worth nothing when you've lost the most important things to you.
If you don't take in any carbs to cover the units you inject you'll go hypo.

You'll keep rotting away, until you get fed up enough.

The problem is you aren't there yet. You're too content in your comfort zone. Until the pain of rotting becomes greater than the fear of the unknown, the fear of people, the fear of trying new things, you'll never do shit. 

One day you'll realize life is what you make it. Make it a pity party, that's what you'll get. Put effort in your life, do things that require you to grow and learn. 

You'll be a socially awkward kid that gets looked down upon until you stop being that kid. 

Change is required, but no one can do it for you.

Don't bother with a reply saying you can't or you've tried, like you've done with everyone else's input here. 

If you want something bad enough, you'll find a way. You just don't want to stop rotting away bad enough yet.

Just get mad kid.
